Grounding check: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL's API date (2026-10-15) matches the coverage day, confirming this is genuinely breaking integration news rather than retro coverage, and it's backed by a [cited **Hermes Bench** score](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-e1857a6ca493).

**Roadmap & Consumer Push:** **Teknium** [leaned hard into the mass-market pitch](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-d669df69a73a), confirming a **mobile app** ETA of roughly 1.5 months, subscription-bundled agent instances, a Desktop consumer pivot, and **Microsoft**/**Google** [integrations 'soon' but blocked on legal review](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-8b6dd67d7534). The flashiest reveal: [the mobile app will remotely control your computer, 'putting every app on your phone.'](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-ec8718e013ee) Community sentiment reads as bullish, with critics answered head-on.

**Community Tooling:** **rlaope**'s **oh-my-hermes (OMH)** plugin — [one-install subagent routing plus long-term memory, a coding harness, and expert skills](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-b84d15a8a0b3) — drew the best community engagement in the batch, signaling a healthy builder ecosystem around Hermes Agent. Community perf-chatter (same author) also surfaced an [**848 tok/s DeepSeek V4.1 Flash** deployment](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-52817ec0502e).

**Teasers & Visibility:** The cryptic ['Hermes Agent Spotted 👀' tease](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-f2aa02a58658) pulled 632 likes / 18k views, and the [official tagline post ('an agent for the projects that matter most')](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-1fa7e6b5f76a) hit 457 likes / 35.8k views — strong buzz heading into the mobile launch window.

**Deprioritized (off-topic):** SakanaAI's **[AI Scientist v3 (The Agentic Scientist)](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-d219ddb323c4)** thread — including the [**AutoIllustrate** companion tool](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-f101f248f4a4) and the [ALIFE 2026 oral](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-4119864af7d5) — was the biggest non-Hermes story in the data but was excluded from the top ranking for relevance to a Hermes newsletter, as were low-substance asides ([bot snark](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-b9fab5f19943), [moderation moments](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-c5dd62198290), [emoji-only replies](/?date=2026-10-16&category=social#item-7b58800e4906)).
